title: Abductees whose memories come back when they see the cover of Communion

tellings.quote: they'll see the cover of Communion, Whitley Streamer's book.

plain: Some abductees, meaning people who say beings took them, are said to have had their buried memories come flooding back just from seeing the cover of Communion, a book by the writer Whitley Strieber about his own encounters, on a bookstore shelf. Michels passes this on from Strieber himself. It would suggest the memories were there all along, waiting for a trigger.
